description.en: OfferPilot's local job-search MCP integration for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: OfferPilot 本地求职助手：连接投递、简历、面试日程和知识资料。

description.en: Connect to an existing local OfferPilot MCP backend. Read authorized applications, resumes, interview schedules, notes and knowledge. Writes remain proposals requiring independent user approval. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and a separately installed OfferPilot backend.
description.zh: 连接已安装的本地 OfferPilot MCP 后端，查询已授权的投递、简历、面试日程、笔记与知识资料。写入仅生成提案，仍需用户独立审批。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5；本插件不附带 Python 后端。
